thread:
maya: Morning — quick async drop-in. TL;DR: microbatch bench p95 regressed ~6% after last kernel change.

maya: What I did: rolled kernel v3.21 -> ran microbatch bench against optimized build, collected traces and perf counters, uploaded logs to gist <https://gist.github.com/maya/bench-613579>.

maya: Blocker: can't reproduce on my dev laptop or debug containers; only reproducible on canary shard (slot-12).

sam: @maya I saw a blip on canary earlier too — thought kv-warmup might be adding tail. Can you paste the exact bench command?

maya: bench command: ```./bin/run_micro_bench --model=redwood-7b --seq=128 --clients=64 --duration=300 --trace=on``` Logs: <https://gist.github.com/maya/bench-613579>

oliver: I can run the same on slot-12 tomorrow AM. Noticed `sched_wait>3ms` spikes in the logs — could be batching window shift.

rachel: FYI I rolled a tiny prefetch timing tweak yesterday (PR #4321) that bumped wake timing by ~1ms. Not expecting kernel perf impact but leaving note. :thinking_face:

maya: @rachel can you drop the PR link here?

rachel: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4321> — moved prefetch wake to later by 1ms, added a small guard.

sam: I'll flip a flag to disable that prefetch tweak on canary and re-run. @ops-bot can you schedule a 30m canary bench job on slot-12 with env `PREFETCH_TWEAK=0`? :pray:

ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary job 6135792060 on slot-12 with env PREFETCH_TWEAK=0. Status: queued.

maya: Also dropping a short trace snippet that looks odd: ```TRACE: batch_size=12 latency=8.5ms loop=4 p95=62ms sched_wait=3.8ms```

oliver: :eyes: If disabling the tweak brings p95 back we should roll rachel's change. Sam please post numbers when done.

sam: Running now. If flaky I'll collect counters with `perf record -e cycles:u -a -- ./bin/run_micro_bench ...` and upload.

maya: :thumbsup: I added perf counter capture to the bench harness (PR here) <https://github.com/redwood-inference/perf-harness/pull/89>.

ops-bot: ci-bot: perf-harness PR 89 passed CI and was merged by ops-bot.

sam: Result: canary job finished — PREFETCH_TWEAK=0 lowered p95 back toward baseline. Before: 62ms, after: 58ms, baseline: 55ms. Opening rollback PR for prefetch tweak now.

rachel: Thanks for verifying — will review rollback PR and follow up. Sorry for the churn. :handshake:

maya: Plan for today: follow rollback review, run additional slot-12 runs to confirm, update perf alert thresholds if needed, and coordinate with infra for deeper sched tracing if it recurs. Ping me here for logs or quick pairing.

sam: I'll post the rollback PR link and short diff when ready.

maya: Thanks team.
